matchupItemFlags: no armor vs a 3-physical enemy comp

notes: Their main damage was Kira (41k physical); 2/5 of us itemized armor.
Enemy ran 1/5 on or near their meta core — they were off-meta too, the win was there.

coaching.headline: They won nine fights to our one and took the majors 32 to 9 — the map belonged to them from the 8-minute Fangtooth on.
coaching.team: Four lanes read 'theirs all game' and the team kept fighting into it anyway: the 11.8, 20.1 and 26.3 losses were two-man fights taken while the losing lanes sat pinned, and every one of their Fangtooths at 8, 18 and 23 was priced by our deaths in the minute before it. The one great moment was the 28.5 fight — won 5-2 and cashed into Orb Prime at 31, proof this comp could fight when everyone committed — but the 0-3 at our own Orb Prime pit right after handed Primal Fangtooth straight back. With reads that bad the play is decline, farm and group.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 0-3 at their Fangtooth at 22.5 bought their third Fangtooth of the night, and the 31-minute 0-3 at our Orb Prime gave away Primal Fangtooth one minute after our only cashed win.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 won the only favored matchup and buried the map in vision — 31 wards — but died ten times, and the falls at 7.6, 16.9, 22.7 and 31 each priced out a Fangtooth or the Primal. A peel tank who is repeatedly the first body down is peeling for nobody; with four lanes losing, keeping the carry standing was worth more than any trade.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim fought the uphill hard — 8 kills including three on Iggy & Scorch — but the jungle read was 'theirs all game' and the trades agreed: seven deaths, no armor into Kira's 41k physical, and the falls at 17.3, 22.5 and 31.9 each preceded a lost Fangtooth or Primal. Yin wants isolated duels; this map offered none, so the path was farm and five-man fights like the 28.5 win.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs took Sevarog into a Greystone lane read 'theirs all game' and kept it quiet — 1/3/3 with a team-high 58379 mitigated. The 24.8 solo catch by Greystone was the one clean mistake; a late-scaling Soul-stacker has every reason to concede ground and stack rather than duel the immortal in his own lane.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Grux. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
ourKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
ourKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
ourKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
ourKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
ourKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
ourKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
ourKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

ourKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
ourKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
ourKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
ourKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
enemyKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

fedBy: Tainted Scepter (Malice): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice.• Stacks up to 15 times.• Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly.• Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
ultPlus: Timewarp (Chime): Every 8s: Subtract 1s from Non-Ultimate Cooldowns.
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 3 times in 37 minutes, fewer deaths than about 80% of Iggy & Scorch mid players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Inferno at top rank: 85s base, about 55.6s by the end (35% shorter) from 53 ability haste: Megacosm 10, Timewarp 25, Tainted Scepter 10, Epoch 8.
17 takedowns (10 kills, 7 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice).
Timewarp (Chime): Every 8s: Subtract 1s from Non-Ultimate Cooldowns.
Iggy & Scorch dealt 38,078 hero damage, 26% of their team's, with +420 magical power from items.

Penetration: Wraith Leggings 11, Caustica ignores 35%; against Steel (level 17 estimated: about 100 magical armor, 54 after penetration) and Sevarog (level 17 estimated: about 139 magical armor, 80 after penetration) that is about 30% and 33% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes: Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as Damage over 3s.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Sustain: Tainted Scepter: On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.; 2,702 healing recorded.
Toughness: +450 health; took 20,245 damage, mitigated 11,293, died 3 times.

Lesson: Iggy & Scorch's penetration cut through: Steel took about 30% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 100, about 54 after 11 flat + 35% penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Megacosm, Wraith Leggings, Caustica. Iggy & Scorch has 4 damaging abilities (Molotov, Oil Spill, Inferno hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 53 ability haste brought them back 35% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Iggy & Scorch killed built magical armor (Steel, Sevarog). We killed Iggy & Scorch 3 times.
Copy it? Too few Iggy & Scorch midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

card.lesson: Inferno came back about every 56s instead of 85s by the end (35% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

Warlord's Challenge at top rank: 90s base, about 69.2s by the end (23% shorter) from 30 ability haste: Dawnstar 10, Basilisk 20.
Grux dealt 14,025 hero damage, 9% of their team's, with +40 physical power from items.
Dawnstar (item): On Basic Attacking Heroes: Reduce their damage dealt by 2.5% for 3s. Stacks up to 5 times. Melee basic attacks apply 2 stacks.
Warden's Faith (item): Take 20% less damage from Critical Strikes.
Lust For Blood (augment): Heal for 5-11.3% of damage dealt to Enemies afflicted with Max Bloodlust stacks. Increases with Hero Level.
Sustain: Sanctification: Grants yourself and nearby Heroes a 150 (+8%) Shield for 3s. While the Shield holds, Heroes gain 50% Tenacity.; 10,501 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1545 health, +140 physical armor, +85 magical armor, +30% tenacity; took 45,328 damage, mitigated 51,863, died 4 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Dawnstar, Frostguard.
Countered? 1 of the 2 players Grux killed built physical armor (Steel). We killed Grux 4 times.
Copy it? Too few Grux support games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.
